scenarios.prompt: Two loadouts have different win rates across ranked and casual queues. Define a versioned balance objective and denominator before tuning either option.

criteria.policy: Stable balance_policy_id/revision and objective are explicit.

criteria.ownership: Changes route to the owning gameplay/economy system and preserve stated guardrails.
